dct_description_sm: Data compiled by the University of Toronto Data Library Service. Data cleanup performed by Laura Devouge, Jessica Gallinger, Hannah Loshak, Kim Pham, and Jessica Samuels.   LF86B04 - labour force 15 years and over by occupation major groups (25) (based on the 1980 classification), and sex (3).  LF86B05 - labour force 15 years and over by industry divisions (21) (based on the 1980 classification - unspecified or undefined distributed among industry divisions), and sex (3)
